geometry_comparison.scope: Real attention geometry only; full-model memory and step throughput are separate measurements
geometry_comparison.timing: One full warmup per backend and case, followed by measurements; profiler adds overhead to the profiled repetition

timing_scope: CUDA intervals around SDPA calls and gradient edges include enqueue gaps; recompute/backward windows may overlap. These are not pure kernel times or training throughput.
memory_scope: Incremental SDPA allocator peaks start after any KV repeat; full backbone peak reported separately.
